prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: parking lot collision in Houston, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported knee injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1426; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Officers responded to a report of a two-vehicle collision in a commercial parking lot in Houston, Texas. Upon arrival, the vehicles were stationary with visible front-end damage to Driver 1's vehicle and rear-quarter damage to Driver 2's vehicle. The damage pattern was consistent with the impact described by both drivers. Driver 1 stated that Driver 2 reversed into the front of the vehicle while Driver 1 was proceeding slowly through a parking aisle. Driver 2 acknowledged the contact and did not dispute the sequence of events. Two independent witnesses on scene gave statements matching this account, and photographs taken at the scene were reviewed. Officers confirmed that Passenger was seated in Driver 1's vehicle at the time of impact. Driver 1 reported pain in the left knee, which was observed to be swollen, and was evaluated by emergency medical personnel. Driver 1 presented proof of insurance listing Driver 1 as a named driver on the policy. No prior damage to the vehicle was reported or observed.
